title: Giving a sub-plan a name
idea: MEET: a named sub-plan is a little job you can refer to by name. Still just the idea - no code.

exercises.prompt: You spotted a repeated job: 'print a star border'. Instead of re-typing it, you give it a NAME. What is that named job called (the big idea)?
options: A sub-plan - a named little job you can refer to
exercises.explanation: A named sub-plan is a small job with a name. Programmers call this idea a 'function'. You refer to it by name.

exercises.prompt: Giving a job a name lets you refer to the whole job just by saying its name.
exercises.explanation: Yes. Once 'print the border' has a name, you can say that name instead of listing every step again.

exercises.prompt: The programming word for a named sub-plan is...
exercises.explanation: A function is just a named sub-plan - a job you name once and use by name. That's the whole idea for now.

exercises.prompt: Why give a job a name at all?
options: So you can reuse the job without rewriting its steps
exercises.explanation: A name lets you reuse the job. Say the name, and the whole job happens - no re-typing the steps.

exercises.prompt: Which are GOOD names for a sub-plan (they say what the job does)? (Pick all.)
exercises.explanation: 'print_banner' and 'show_menu' describe their jobs. 'x' and 'thing' say nothing - poor names.

exercises.prompt: Match each repeated job to a clear sub-plan name.
exercises.explanation: A sub-plan's name should echo its job. Clear names make the main plan read like plain English.

exercises.prompt: A named sub-plan is the same core idea as decomposition from the last unit, now with a NAME attached.
exercises.explanation: Exactly. You split into jobs (decomposition); now you name a reusable job. The name is the new piece.

exercises.prompt: REVIEW: naming a sub-plan clearly is like naming a variable clearly. A good variable name is...
exercises.explanation: Same habit: descriptive names. 'ticket_price' tells you its meaning; 'p' hides it. Names should explain.

exercises.prompt: Once a job has a name, the main plan can...
options: mention the name wherever the job is needed
exercises.explanation: The main plan just names the job at each spot it's needed. One name, used as many times as you like.

exercises.prompt: The big idea of this unit:
options: a repeated or important job can be NAMED and reused by name
every job must be rewritten each time
exercises.explanation: Name a reusable job once, then use its name. This idea - the function - is what you'll write as code next unit.
